title: The Rubik's Cube Record Dropped From 22 To 3 Seconds
hook: A robot crushed decades of human cube records.
closing: Human speed kept rising, then a machine reset the scale.
question: How fast can you solve one?

segments.say: The first championship record was 22.95 seconds. That became the benchmark for human hands.
The human record fell to 3.13 seconds. Decades of technique removed nearly every pause.
A robot solved it in 0.38 seconds. Machines now operate on a different speed scale.
